posts.title: Engineering Text-to-Elasticsearch DSL with LLMs: Constraints, Safety, and Trust
posts.description: Turning user intent into validated Elasticsearch queries with guardrails. TL;DR Problem: Vectors are great at meaning, bad at hard constraints (years, owners, statuses, permissions). Approach: LLM translates text → typed IR → deterministic compilation into DSL/ES|QL, under a strict allowlist. posts.title: Redefining RAG Evaluation: A Set-Based Approach (Beyond nDCG)
posts.description: TL;DR The Problem: Traditional metrics like nDCG assume a human scrolling a ranked list. In RAG, the “user” is an LLM consuming a fixed, unordered set of passages. The Solution: A new metric, RA-nWG@K (Rarity-Aware Normalized Weighted Gain). posts.title: How Proper Names Behave in Text Embedding Space
posts.description: TL;DR The Surprise: Dense “semantic” retrievers work better on proper names than expected. In a RAG system over scientific papers, author names showed real signal—not perfect, but far from random. The Experiment: Built a diagnostic with synthetic authors (to avoid memorization) and measured name margin (how much the model prefers the right author) vs topic margin .
